items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: I detect no... Influence of Fountain's playing on anybody around. I... It's interesting to wonder about who influenced him.

ctx.x: Well, certainly he's not played as much as Fountain, and you don't feel that Fountain has... Uh... Uh... An influence, uh... In style, or in anything except, uh... Say... General jazz, uh... Overall... Effectiveness.
No. I detect no... Influence of Fountain's playing on anybody around. I... It's interesting to wonder about who influenced him. Uh-huh. But it seems to me that he's a... An accomplished...

Well, let's... Let's go back a few years. Uh... It's possible that, uh... Uh... Fountain was influenced by, uh... A player that he admired very much, and we did get to know, uh... Fazzola. Uh... Do you think there's such a thing as a Fazzola influence in Chicago today?
